title: TagSort read result
description: Every tag TagSort found in one image. Coordinates are in pixels of the original image after EXIF rotation, with the origin at the top-left corner, x to the right and y down.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the result follows.

engine_version.description: Version of the TagSort engine that produced the result.

model_version.description: Versions of the models used, for example det-1.0+rec-1.0.

tags.description: Tags found in the image, possibly none.

timings_ms.description: Time spent in each pipeline stage, in milliseconds.

other_texts.description: Only with open reading (docs/open-reading.md): lines of text that fit no kind of tag of the profile, most likely tags first. Absent otherwise.

text.description: What the recognizer read, without the help of any pattern.

confidence.description: How sure the recognizer is of the characters, in [0, 1].

tag_likelihood.description: How likely the text is a specimen tag, in [0, 1], from generic cues; not a calibrated probability yet.

kind_guess.description: id: looks like a specimen number. header: printed words. noise: rulers, stray marks.

polygon.description: Corners of the line, clockwise, starting at the top-left corner of the upright text.

angle.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees from upright, in [0, 360).

width.description: Width in pixels, after EXIF rotation.

height.description: Height in pixels, after EXIF rotation.

exif_rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees applied to the stored pixels to honor the EXIF orientation.

tag_id.description: Id of the profile tag this text matches, or null when it matches none.

text.description: Text read on the tag, or null when the tag is unreadable.

confidence.description: Calibrated probability that text is exactly right.

status.description: accepted: confident reading. review: a person should check it. unreadable: no reading.

polygon.description: Corners of the tag, clockwise, starting at the top-left corner of the upright text.

angle.description: Orientation of the tag text in the image: clockwise rotation in degrees from upright, in [0, 360). 0 means the text reads left to right, 90 top to bottom, 180 upside down.

candidates.description: Other possible readings, most likely first.

source.description: local: read by the on-device models. fallback: read by the vision API fallback.
